resources.string: five long presses of the Glyph button crack it

Every day a new pet comes as an egg, never one you have. Common ones come most often, legendary ones rarely, mythic ones almost never. Tap an egg to put it on the matrix, tap a pet to see its three forms.
Every pet you do not have yet, as an egg right away
Support n7 and get every pet now
One-time purchase. Everything else in the game is free.
Activate Glyph Pet in Glyph Toys
Hold the Glyph button to feed, and a full pet plays a mini-game. Shake it to see its signature, or to grow a pet that is ready
Set it as the Always-on Glyph Toy to keep it with you
Every day you play, a new pet comes as an egg, always one you do not have yet. Put it on the matrix and hold the Glyph button five times: it hatches.

The pet lives on the back of your phone, or in the app. Hold the Glyph button to feed it; a full one starts a mini-game you steer by tilting. Tap the back twice to stroke it. A shake shows its signature, or grows it once it is ready.
Every new pet joins your nursery. Ten are common, thirteen rare, four legendary and two mythic. Its album shows which of its animations you have seen.
Without it the pet will not show up on the back of your phone. Add Glyph Pet to your Glyph Toys.

The matrix goes out while the phone lies screen up or is in a pocket, and lights up again when you pick it up.
The phone answers with a soft tap when you feed the pet, crack an egg, play or watch it grow. Never while it sleeps. Follows the system touch feedback setting.
✦ Shiny: a rare find, one hatch in twenty
Hears you with the app closed
Android lets an app hear only while it is open. With this on, a silent notification keeps the pet hearing blowing, claps and typing after you close the app. After a restart, open the app once.
Blowing, claps and typing reach the pet on the matrix. Nothing is recorded.
Blow on the pet and the wind carries it; clap and it starts. Only while it is live on the matrix, and only how loud it is: nothing is recorded or sent.
The pet looks up when a notification comes and shows a phone while a call is missed. Glyph Pet sees only the kind of a notification, never its text.

Drop by for a couple of minutes when you have time. One meal is a dot of food. Every 10 seconds of a game is a dot of joy; the game costs a dot of energy. Worn out, it naps for about forty seconds; turn the phone over or charge it and it rests fast. It grows while it is on the screen, awake and fed: a teen in 15 minutes, an adult an hour later.
